description: Election Commission - Mrs. U. G. T. de Silva, Mr. R. D. C. Karunasena and Mrs. K. A. R. T. Kobewatta have vacated from the membership of Pasbage Korale Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under Section 10 A(1)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific members of the Pasbage Korale Pradeshiya Sabha have vacated their offices due to ceasing to be members of the United National Party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, falling clearly under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about elected officials.
